scenes.name: Triangles & Light / 三角与光
scenes.description: 程序化生成的三角网格与一束跟随鼠标的光。切片密度、网格与光源的环境色/漫反射色、光源距离都可调。 / Procedural triangle mesh lit by a cursor-following light. Slice density, mesh/light ambient & diffuse colours and light distance are adjustable.
scenes.author: Maksim Surguy

params.label: Mesh Ambient / 网格环境光
params.description: Ambient colour of the triangle mesh. / 三角网格的环境光颜色。

params.label: Mesh Diffuse / 网格漫反射
params.description: Diffuse colour of the triangle mesh. / 三角网格的漫反射颜色。

params.label: Slices / 切片数
params.description: Mesh subdivision count: higher = finer triangles, more CPU. / 网格细分数量：越大三角形越密，CPU 占用越高。

params.label: Light Ambient / 光源环境光
params.description: Ambient colour of the cursor light. / 跟随鼠标的光源环境色。

params.label: Light Diffuse / 光源漫反射
params.description: Diffuse colour of the cursor light. / 跟随鼠标的光源漫反射色。

params.label: Light Distance / 光源距离
params.description: Distance from the light to the mesh: larger = softer, wider glow. / 光源到网格的距离：越大光斑越散。

params.label: Mouse Follow / 鼠标跟随
params.description: Off: the light stops following the cursor. Original wallpaper toggles this with the space key. / 关闭：光斑停止跟随鼠标（原作通过空格键切换）。
